title: Q
body: Hi, is your solution open source? The app is great but there’s also a room for development (like yes/no habits or quit habits).
author: ooptt

title: All good but…
body: How do you remove a note? There is literally no option to do that. Also does the data you collect include our journal entries? It wasn’t specifically stated in the privacy policy (nor was it denied), but from what I’ve read I probably need to assume that it does include them. I’m aware that you need to get money from somewhere since this app is 100% free (for which I’m very glad), but I wish there was more transparency on your side.

title: Greatest habit app that I ever used
body:
The app understand that simplicity is key to perfection. 
Have all necessary features is fully functional and have no bugs.
Another positive surprise is that app don’t ask you for your data.
